candidate: I: no discovery bootstrap, automatic verified completion + final-decision reserve
public_trace_findings: The public artist-extremum task used the grounded baseline workflow, automatic completion supplied the exact concise title, and the task succeeded in 72.6 seconds.
The album-play task emitted an incorrect confident completion without any play_music call; its code also used plays rather than play_count and its final reason claimed an unsupported correction.
The final-decision reserve can therefore elicit premature success claims as well as finalization; observed Supervisor completion is not proof of task correctness.
Private Venmo/Spotify tasks still suffered requester/auth/docs loops; the previous-song task did not succeed without onboarding in this sample.
decision: No-bootstrap I is simpler and faster than G/H for public answer tasks but not sufficient for private/player tasks. Compare authenticated K; then consider objective-adaptive onboarding rather than globally enabling bootstrap. Preserve the incorrect completion as an error-awareness and mutation-verification target.
